title: Thavamai Thavamirunthu
desc: Saradha and Muthaiah, a village-based couple, face financial difficulties while raising their two sons, Ramanathan and Ramalingam. Problems escalate when Ramalingam gets his girlfriend pregnant.

title: Mamiyargal Jakkirathai
desc: Selvi, a young educated girl, gets ill-treated at her husband's house in the name of dowry. Later, she decides to set her mother-in-law straight.

title: Raththa Dhanam
desc: A young man who sacrifices his blood and life for his lover who is in need of a heart transplant, faces many challenges from his family and society.

title: Azhagana Naatkal
desc: Chandru agrees to marry the girl of his father's choice when his lover, Indu, goes missing. However, Chandru faces a tough predicament when Indu returns with a young girl and claims he is the father.

title: Deva
desc: Deva and Bharathi are in love and plan on getting married until her father opposes their relationship. Can Deva prove himself to be a worthy suitor?
